name: Background extraction
notes: Placed 108 samples on a 12 x 9 grid, 25 px boxes, 108 accepted and 0 rejected.
Rejected: 0 brighter than the background estimate, 0 on the edge margin, 0 clipped, 0 non-finite.
Every rejected sample is still in the record, with the reason it was rejected.
Thin-plate spline through the 108 accepted samples, smoothing 0.1, per channel and unlinked.
Evaluated on every 8th pixel and interpolated between; measured against direct evaluation at 1000 pixels, worst case 0.00014 of one 8-bit level.

Corrected by subtraction, returning each channel its own model median as the pedestal (R 0.01099, G 0.01249, B 0.00950). The background LEVEL is preserved and only the variation is removed, so the ratio between channels is unchanged and no colour grading happened.
4 pixels came out below zero, which is expected: noise that sat under the model stays under it, and nothing is clamped until the 8-bit step.

name: Colour calibration
notes: Stellar gains: only 0 pixels are between the star thresholds (0.000% of the frame); 2000 are needed.

Star selection is a brightness cut, not star detection: bright unsaturated pixels are predominantly stars in a star field. Pixels whose neighbourhood is also mostly selected are rejected as extended, which removes a galaxy core but would also remove a star field dense enough to look like one.

stars.skipReason: only 0 pixels are between the star thresholds (0.000% of the frame); 2000 are needed

hueFidelity.note: preserved by construction; this measures the implementation, not the design

chromaNoise.note: measured on the pixels the mask leaves at k = 1; with the mask wired correctly this cannot grow, so it verifies the mask is on, not that the mask is right

noise.note: first difference of horizontally adjacent sky pixels, divided by sqrt(2) to read as a per-pixel sigma; measured on the same sky on both frames, chosen once on the full one

name: Suggested crop
reason: every lit pixel sits in an empty neighbourhood, so this frame has stars and no extended object to crop to

name: Quantise to 8-bit
notes: Dithered by plus or minus 0.5 of one level before rounding, from a fixed seed (20260906), so the result is reproducible from the same file.
0 values below black and 0 above white were clamped here, out of 5760000.
